speaker_role: independent counselor (Katrina Marie, Well Rounded Admissions Consulting)
commercial_incentive: Yes - references 'my students' and promotes her consulting channel/other videos
key_insights: Lists nine components of holistic review: grades/GPA in school context via the school profile; teacher recommendation letters; counselor recommendation letters (which speak more to in/out-of-classroom growth over four years); the personal statement/short answers; demographic and socioeconomic background; community involvement/extracurriculars (recommends 1-2 deeply committed activities over 20 shallow ones); possible interviews; portfolios for arts-specific programs; and documentation of learning disabilities/accommodations to contextualize academic dips
Distinguishes teacher recs (focused on classroom learning style, usually junior/senior year teachers) from counselor recs (focused on four-year growth and outside-classroom character)
Frames socioeconomic/demographic disclosure as helping admissions understand context behind grade fluctuations, school changes, or financial aid need
notable_or_distinctive: Standard nine-point checklist format; no unusual data points or unique institutional detail beyond typical holistic-review explainer content.
reliability_notes: Generic, high-level advice with no cited statistics, specific schools, or dates; content is consistent with widely known holistic admissions concepts but adds little beyond what's found in many similar videos, and the video itself is roughly 7 years old per the manifest so some specifics could be dated.
